children: MariMed filed a definitive proxy statement to seek stockholder approval for a reverse stock split aimed at enabling a potential U.S. national exchange listing.
Filed definitive proxy statement with the SEC to solicit votes for a reverse stock split proposal for the special meeting.
Proposal would authorize the Board to implement a reverse split at a ratio between 1-for-50 and 1-for-100, timing/discretion retained by the Board.
Purpose: provide flexibility to meet minimum share price and other requirements for a potential U.S. national exchange listing.
No fractional shares to be issued; holders entitled to fractional shares would receive cash in lieu of fractional shares.
Virtual Special Meeting set for Oct 28, 2026; record date for voting is Sept 4, 2026; outcome not guaranteed and Board may decide not to effect the split.
